Citymaker.Roads.Name: Roads
Citymaker.Roads.Control.pattern.Tooltip: How the streets are laid out inside the area.
Citymaker.Roads.Option.pattern.grid.Tool: Straight streets in a regular grid, aligned with the longest side of the area.
Citymaker.Roads.Option.pattern.tree.Tool: A collector along the area with branches ending in pairs of cul-de-sacs.
Citymaker.Roads.Option.pattern.organic.T: Winding streets with cul-de-sacs and a few loops, like a suburban subdivision.
Citymaker.Roads.Option.pattern.contour.T: Streets follow the terrain's contour lines, linked by gentle uphill roads. Needs sloped terrain.
Citymaker.Roads.Option.pattern.mixed.Too: A radial centre with a roundabout, surrounded by organic streets.
Citymaker.Roads.Option.pattern.loop.Tool: Widely spaced collectors with a looping local street inside each large block.
Citymaker.Roads.Option.pattern.superbloc: Collectors around groups of 3 × 3 blocks with car-free streets inside.
Citymaker.Roads.Option.pattern.concentri: Rings that follow the shape of the area, joined by connecting streets.
Citymaker.Roads.Option.pattern.radial.To: A central roundabout with straight avenues out to the edge, optionally crossed by circular rings.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.roadMix.Tooltip: Which road goes where, in one pick. It sets the street, avenue, local, roundabout and perimeter roads and their upgrades below; changing any of them makes it Custom.
Citymaker.Roads.Option.roadMix.auto.Tool: The standard mix: Two-Lane Roads for streets, Four-Lane Roads for avenues, a Two-Lane One-Way Road around roundabouts.
Citymaker.Roads.Option.roadMix.quiet.Too: Two-Lane Roads everywhere, even the avenues, with street trees and grass verges. Calm streets for houses.
Citymaker.Roads.Option.roadMix.alleys.To: Narrow two-way Alleys between the blocks; Two-Lane Roads for the avenues and the edge.
Citymaker.Roads.Option.roadMix.pedestria: Pedestrian Streets inside (service vehicles only); cars stay on the Two-Lane avenues and the perimeter road.
Citymaker.Roads.Option.roadMix.boulevard: Tree-lined Two-Lane streets and divided Four-Lane avenues with trees in the median.
Streets: Two-Lane + trees · Avenues: Four-Lane Divided + median trees
A busy core: Four-Lane streets, Six-Lane avenues and three-lane one-way roundabout rings.
Citymaker.Roads.Option.roadMix.bike.Tool: The standard mix with bike lanes on every street and avenue.
Citymaker.Roads.Option.roadMix.bike.Deta: Streets: Two-Lane + bike lanes · Avenues: Four-Lane + bike lanes
Citymaker.Roads.Option.roadMix.country.T: Gravel Roads for villages and farmland; a Two-Lane Road for the through routes and the edge.
Citymaker.Roads.Option.roadMix.custom.To: Your own picks: choose each road below.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.streetAsset.Tool: The road for ordinary streets (and the perimeter road unless it has its own pick). Automatic places a Two-Lane Road.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.localAsset.Toolt: The road for cul-de-sacs and short local streets. Automatic uses the street road (a Two-Lane Road by default).
Citymaker.Roads.Control.localAsset.Descr: Dead ends and small side streets.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.avenueAsset.Tool: The road for avenues and collectors, the main lines through the layout. Automatic places a Four-Lane Road.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.avenueAsset.Desc: Wider main roads through the grid.
The one-way road that circles a roundabout island. Automatic places a Two-Lane One-Way Road: two lanes in the ring direction, like the Four-Lane avenue that feeds it. Only used when the layout has roundabouts (Radial, Mixed, Grid avenue crossings).
The one-way ring of a roundabout.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.perimeterAsset.T: The loop around the edge of a drawn or painted area. Automatic uses the street road.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.perimeterAsset.D: The road around the edge of the area.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.pathAsset.Toolti: Path used for the walkways and for the car-free streets inside superblocks. Automatic places a Pavement Path (dirt trails take a trail path when your playset has one).
Citymaker.Roads.Control.angle.Tooltip: Rotates the layout relative to the longest side of the area.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.alignTerrain.Too: Turns the layout so one set of streets follows the slope's contour lines.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.gridMode.Tooltip: Size blocks by distance, or by a number of columns and rows that fill the area.
Citymaker.Roads.Option.gridMode.count.To: A fixed number of columns and rows spread evenly over the area.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.gridColumns.Tool: Number of streets across the area's length.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.gridRows.Tooltip: Number of streets across the area's width.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.culDeSacs.Toolti: Turns some grid streets into dead ends with a turning circle.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.culDeSacFrequenc: Share of blocks that get a cul-de-sac.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.culDeSacDepth.To: How far a cul-de-sac reaches into its block.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.culDeSacStaggere: Alternates the side cul-de-sacs start from, block after block.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.capStyle.Tooltip: Decoration placed at the end of every cul-de-sac.
Citymaker.Roads.Option.capStyle.grass.To: Turning circle with a grass island.
Citymaker.Roads.Option.capStyle.trees.To: Turning circle with trees in the middle.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.capSize.Tooltip: Size of the turning circle. Automatic matches the road width.
Citymaker.Roads.Option.capSize.xl.Toolti: Extra large turning circle (not available in asphalt).
Citymaker.Roads.Control.avenueColumn.Too: Makes one column of the grid an avenue.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.avenueRow.Toolti: Makes one row of the grid an avenue.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.avenueIndex.Tool: Which column or row becomes the avenue, counted from the first street.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.roundaboutIsland: Places a roundabout island where the avenue column and row meet.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.treeBranchSpacin: Distance between two branches on the same side of the collector.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.treeCulDeSacSpac: Distance between two pairs of cul-de-sacs along a branch.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.loops.Tooltip: Share of branches that join another street instead of ending in a cul-de-sac.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.variation.Toolti: Another random layout with the same settings.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.contourLinkSpaci: Distance between roads that climb from one level street to the next.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.avenues.Tooltip: Number of straight avenues leaving the central roundabout.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.loopCollectorSpa: Distance between collectors; each large block between them gets its own loop.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.superblockZone.T: Size of each block inside a superblock.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.rings.Tooltip: Number of rings. Fewer are built when the area is too narrow for them.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.concentricConnec: Number of streets linking the innermost ring outwards.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.roundaboutRadius: Radius of the central roundabout (reduced to fit the area).
Citymaker.Roads.Control.perimeterRoad.To: A road around the edge of the area that the new streets connect to.
Citymaker.Roads.Option.perimeterRoad.aut: On for drawn and painted areas; off for picked blocks, which are already surrounded by roads.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.perimeterCornerR: Radius of the perimeter road at the corners of a drawn or painted area. Small keeps the road on your outline (never tighter than the road can turn); the winding styles use more.
Joins new streets to the roads they meet or cross.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.avoidObstacles.T: Leaves out streets that would cross water, buildings or power line pylons, without leaving dead-end stubs.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.followTerrain.To: Roads follow the ground. Off: the whole network stays at the area's average height.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.edgeDepth.Toolti: How deep the strips along the new streets reach into each block (used by zoning and other add-ons).
Citymaker.Roads.Control.streetTrees.Tool: Trees along both sides of the streets.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.streetGrass.Tool: Grass strips along the streets (not with wide sidewalks).
Bike lanes on both sides of the streets.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.avenueTrees.Tool: Trees along both sides of the avenues.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.avenueGrass.Tool: Grass strips along both sides of the avenues.
Bike lanes on both sides of the avenues.
Citymaker.Roads.Issue.NothingFits: No streets fit in this area with these settings. Try a larger area or smaller spacing.
Citymaker.Roads.Issue.TerrainFlat: The terrain here is flat: the contour pattern has no slope to follow.
Citymaker.Roads.Issue.ObstaclesAvoided: {0} road segments were left out to avoid water and buildings.
Citymaker.Roads.Issue.GenerationFailed: The streets could not be planned: {0}
Citymaker.Roads.Issue.InvalidArea: The area outline is not valid.
Citymaker.Recipe.Roads.Description: A street pattern for the area, connected to the roads around it.
Citymaker.Recipe.RoadsWithParks.Descript: Streets, with a park filling every block between them.
Citymaker.Recipe.RoadsWithZoning.Descrip: Streets, with zoning painted along every new street.
Citymaker.EdgeZoning.Name: Edge zoning
Citymaker.Zone.Type.Tooltip: Which zone the plots get; buildings of that zone grow there.
Citymaker.Zone.commercialLow.Tooltip: Shops and small businesses (low density commercial).
Citymaker.Zone.commercialHigh.Tooltip: Department stores and shop towers (high density commercial).
Citymaker.Zone.mixed.Tooltip: Shops on the ground floor with flats above.
Citymaker.Zone.residentialMedium.Tooltip: Apartment blocks of a few storeys.
Citymaker.EdgeZoning.Control.cutout.Tool: Set by the Zoning feature: zone the whole cutout, however deep.
Citymaker.EdgeZoning.Control.zone.Toolti: A specific zone (mods included) instead of the zone type. Cells already zoned keep their zone.
Citymaker.EdgeZoning.Control.depth.Toolt: How deep the zoning reaches from the road (8 m per cell, 6 cells at most).
Citymaker.EdgeZoning.Issue.NoFrontage: No road runs along this area, so nothing was zoned.
On main roads (avenues): side streets join at most this often (m). Closer side streets end in a cul-de-sac before the avenue (with a footpath to it) or join their neighbours instead. 0 = every side street joins.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.walkways.Tooltip: Footpaths that shorten walks: from cul-de-sacs to the next street or close, through long blocks and through the middle of grid blocks. 0 = none.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.walkwayStyle.Too: Paved footpaths, dirt trails (a trail path when your playset has one, with worn ground painted along it), or a mix.
Citymaker.Roads.Option.walkwayStyle.trai: Dirt or gravel trails with worn ground painted along them (terrain paint is permanent).
Citymaker.Roads.Control.backLanes.Toolti: Small lanes through the middle of the blocks, between two parallel streets (share of the blocks that can take one). Never onto an avenue.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.laneStyle.Toolti: Paved alleys, gravel lanes, or a mix.
Citymaker.Roads.Option.laneStyle.alley.T: The Alley road (or the lane road you pick).
Citymaker.Roads.Control.laneAsset.Toolti: Road used for back lanes. Automatic places the Alley.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.tipStyle.Tooltip: The road of the dead-end streets: the same as their street, gravel, or gravel at some of them.
Citymaker.Roads.Option.tipStyle.gravel.T: Every cul-de-sac is a gravel road from its last junction.
Citymaker.Roads.Option.tipStyle.mixed.To: About half of the cul-de-sacs are gravel roads.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.terrainFit.Toolt: Follow contours lays the streets along the slope (grids bend onto the contour lines, winding streets steer by the hill, too-steep links go). Ignore terrain keeps the pattern strict whatever the ground does.
Citymaker.Roads.Option.terrainFit.auto.T: Each pattern as it is (its own Align to terrain option).
Citymaker.Roads.Option.terrainFit.follow: Streets along the contour lines, gentle climbs between them.
Citymaker.Roads.Option.terrainFit.ignore: The strict pattern, straight over hills.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.landShape.Toolti: Terraced: on a hill every street's lots are levelled across the street, as deep as their zone cells, with a bank at the back of the lots up to the next level; the banks are painted and planted. Flat ground is never touched. Natural: the ground as it is.
Citymaker.Roads.Option.landShape.terrace: Level lots along every street, banks between the levels (sloped ground only).
Citymaker.Roads.Control.maxGrade.Tooltip: The grade the layout aims to stay under (%). Steeper roads are marked in Design; Follow contours removes too-steep links where it can.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.preZone.Tooltip: Zones every cell along every new road with this zone once the roads are built. Cells you zoned before keep their zone.
Citymaker.Roads.Issue.IslandsDropped: {0} road pieces ({1} m) could not be linked to the rest and were left out.
Citymaker.Roads.Issue.NotConnected: These roads could not be linked to the nearby roads: connect them yourself after building.
Citymaker.Roads.Issue.Steep: A road here climbs {0} %, steeper than the steepest road set for this layout.
Streets on the hill's contour lines, each on a level terrace as deep as its zone cells, with banks between and links up the slope.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.terraceCells.Too: Zone cells (8 m each) kept level on each side of a terrace street.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.terraceLinks.Too: How the roads between terraces climb.
Citymaker.Roads.Option.terraceLinks.dire: Straight up where gentle enough, else a long diagonal; switchbacks only where nothing else fits.
Citymaker.Roads.Option.terraceLinks.serp: Zig-zag legs joined by hairpin bends, climbing gently between two terraces.
Citymaker.Roads.Option.terraceLinks.spir: One road winding round and up the hill, crossing every terrace.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.terraceLinkSpaci: How far apart the links up the hill are along a terrace street.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.terraceAvenues.T: The links up the hill are avenues instead of streets.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.terraceFall.Tool: A gentle cross-fall away from the bank so rain drains off (0 = dead level).
Citymaker.Roads.Control.terraceBank.Tool: What stands between two levels: rounded grassy banks or steep straight faces.
A smooth S-shaped bank with rounded edges.
A straight steep face with crisp terrace edges, worn dirt on the face.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.terraceBankSlope: No bank between terraces is steeper than this (50 % = 1 in 2).
Citymaker.Roads.Control.terraceFlat.Tool: Ground already flatter than this is never terraced.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.terraceEarthwork: The deepest cut or highest fill the terraces may make.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.terracePaint.Too: Dry grass and worn dirt on the banks (terrain paint is permanent).
Citymaker.Roads.Control.terraceTrees.Too: Clumps of trees on the banks between the terraces.
Citymaker.Roads.Issue.TerraceSteep: The hill is steeper than terraces this deep allow: they narrow in places. Fewer cells or a steeper bank fit better.
Citymaker.Roads.Issue.TerraceEarthwork: The earthwork is capped at {0} m: in places the terraces follow the hill a little.
Citymaker.Roads.Issue.TerraceFlat: The ground here is flat: the streets are laid in rows and nothing is terraced.
Citymaker.Roads.Issue.DroppedObstacle: Street left out: it would cross a building, water or a pylon and no way round fitted.
Citymaker.Roads.Issue.PerimeterBlocked: Perimeter piece left out: a building, water or a pylon sits on the outline and no way round fitted.
Citymaker.Roads.Issue.PerimeterOpen: The perimeter road does not close here: no clean way across the gap.
Citymaker.Roads.Issue.JunctionCut: Side street cut back from this main road: junctions here are kept this far apart.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.connectTo.Toolti: Which existing roads the new streets may join. Roads they may not join are never crossed either.
Citymaker.Roads.Option.connectTo.streets: Every road except highways and their ramps.
Citymaker.Roads.Option.connectTo.small.T: Two-lane roads, lanes and gravel roads only: the big roads keep their junctions few.
Citymaker.Roads.Option.connectTo.any.Too: Every road, highways and ramps too.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.gridCharacter.To: How perfect the grid stays. Strict: every street straight through, whatever the ground. Automatic: the grid gives way where the site asks (it bends on a hill, streets too steep for cars become steps, land too steep to build becomes a hillside park, a diagonal follows a desire line between two city streets when it is worth it). Lively: more of it, with staggered brick blocks and a square in the middle.
Citymaker.Roads.Option.gridCharacter.str: The plain grid: every street straight through.
Citymaker.Roads.Option.gridCharacter.aut: The grid gives way to hills and desire lines, only where the site asks for it.
Citymaker.Roads.Option.gridCharacter.liv: Staggered brick blocks, a square in the middle, a diagonal along a gentler desire line.
Citymaker.Roads.Control.roadWear.Tooltip: Paints the ground the new streets wear in: worn desire paths where people take shortcuts, worn corners at the junctions, dry verges along the streets. Paint stays when the roads are removed.
Citymaker.Roads.Option.roadWear.subtle.T: A few desire paths, light wear.
